traps.lever: how-type (producer the record redaction never visits): a recorded credential reproduced outside the sensitive header slot
traps.shape: a mocked response reproduces an incoming sensitive header value in its body; the recorded transaction then carries the value into every exposure of the record
traps.where: producer: response templating in packages/commons-server/src/libs/server/server.ts; sink: packages/commons-server/src/libs/utils.ts (value-level redaction) and packages/commons-server/src/libs/server/events-listeners.ts
